experiment_data.hypothesis: Obs-decoder-only SGS on Cheetah Run: cross-environment validation that obs-decoder SGS suppresses CIVO in a second environment. Based on 010b showing Cheetah CIVO (NVE 8.27-70.64×), if obs-decoder SGS works, NVE should stay < 1.5× and eval > 70% of Cheetah baseline (~380+). Tests whether the gradient decomposition finding (obs decoder as critical pathway) generalizes beyond Walker.
